name: Generate UV Atlas
explanation_long: Creates one or more UV atlases depending on given mode (single, separateMaterials or by separateAlpha). Materials are kept retaining any Material Colors and Names. UVs are non-overlapping and global. Warning: This overrides existing UV sets and might therefore lead to issues with existing Texture Sets.

exposed_options.name: Atlas Mode
exposed_options.description: Mode used to assign atlases. Default is separateMaterials, separateAlpha creates UV atlases by opacity (opaque vs transparent materials). Single will create one atlas for the whole mesh.

exposed_options.name: Multiple Atlas Factor
exposed_options.description: Divide each atlas into new atlases. This leads to duplicated atlas count which paired with a low texture resolution (2k) can be a good alternative to fewer atlases with higher texture resolution (4k).

exposed_options.name: Segmentation Cut Angle
exposed_options.description: Threshold in degrees creating UV seams when the angle between triangles is higher than specified value. Increasing degrees creates more cuts, smaller charts, and better UV space utilization.

exposed_options.name: Segmentation Chart Angle
exposed_options.description: Threshold in degrees for curvature of 3D charts. Creates UV seams based on surface curvature, which is determined by averaging surface normals. Lower values create more cuts, smaller charts.

exposed_options.name: Maximum Angle Error
exposed_options.description: Maximum angle difference in degrees between UV and 3D space beyond which a chart is split and re-unwrapped. This can be used to reduce UV distortion, using a smaller angle introduces more splits.
